about_text:
XGo Plus is a membership that gives you real discounts at restaurants, cafés, doctors, salons, car washes and more near you.
Subscribe once, show your QR code at checkout, and save every time.
install_title: Add XGo Plus to your home screen
install_text: Open it like an app — one tap away, full screen.
install_ios_steps:
Tap the Share button (square with an arrow) in Safari
Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”
Tap “Add” — XGo Plus appears on your home screen
install_android_steps:
Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right of Chrome
Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
Tap “Install” — XGo Plus appears on your home screen
